text:
Asha Patel: Quick heads-up — the playbook import from last week created duplicate playbook_metadata rows in CRM. Saw a spike in alerts. Can someone triage?
Miguel Santos: Seeing it now in the logs, looks like the import job retried twice for some customers. Any error snippets?
Asha Patel: Error from the ETL job: `DuplicateKeyError: key (playbook_id, enrollment_step)` repeated for ~120 accounts.
Priya Reddy: That aligns with the old export where `external_playbook_id` was nullable. We should normalize to canonical `playbook_guid` before write.
Miguel Santos: I can add dedupe by (playbook_guid, customer_id) in the ETL, but need to be careful about playbook variants that used external ids.
Samir Cole: We should run a migration to backfill missing `playbook_guid` on rows where `external_playbook_id` exists and map them. I can own rollback. Propose Tue 01:00 UTC (low traffic).
Asha Patel: Agree. Need to communicate to onboarding ops + set a maintenance flag so playbook triggers don't fire while migrating.
playbook-bot: Deploy queued: csops/playbook-etl v2.3.1 by Miguel Santos — scheduled Tue 01:00 UTC :clock1:
Priya Reddy: Also adding a healthscore unit test to capture duplicate-playbook cases (we saw some inflated churn risk because playbook hits doubled). I'll open a PR with test fixtures.
Miguel Santos: Adding feature flag `playbook_dedupe_v2` so we can flip back if anything goes sideways.
Asha Patel: Nice. After migration, we'll need to run an audit to validate active enrollments match historical touchpoints. I'll ping CS leads.
Samir Cole: I'll update runbook and emergency rollback steps in the SOP doc at https://redwood.internal/docs/cs/playbooks/imports
Priya Reddy: If healthscore regressions appear post-migrate, disable the flag and revert to v1. Keep the `playbook_id` to `playbook_guid` mapping handy.
Asha Patel: Thanks team — will post a short postmortem and the checklist after the migration completes. Closing here until the scheduled window.
